      Leaves out: source manifest and checkpoints, raw-snapshot replay, provenance traceability, historical-format validation suite (Stage 4); shared request budget and retries (Stage 5); point-in-time generations and reconciliation (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7); full-history backfill (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: Manifests, replay and traceability
      Objective: Add the source manifest and checkpoints, raw-snapshot replay, provenance traceability and the historical-format validation suite across O1–O3.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: the code shipped by Stages 1–3
      Produces: a source manifest with per-file state; retained raw bytes; replay without SEC requests; a provenance chain from each extract to its submission, its index row and its source file; the historical-format validation suite
      Exit:

        - O2: an interrupted download resumes without re-fetching completed files.
        - O3: any extracted document traces to its submission, its index row and the hash of its source file.
        - The validation suite passes on fixtures for every index format in the supported range.
      Leaves out: shared request budget and retries (Stage 5); point-in-time generations and reconciliation (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7); full-history backfill (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Shared request budget and retries
      Objective: Route all SEC traffic from the index and submission collectors through one shared request budget, with bounded retries.
      Outcomes: O1, O2
      Consumes: Stage 4's source manifest and checkpoints
      Produces: one downloader and request budget shared by every collector; bounded retries; a halt when access is denied
      Exit:
        - O1 and O2: concurrent index and submission collectors together stay at or under the configured rate.
        - 429 and 5xx responses are retried within bounds, honoring Retry-After.
        - A 403 halts the run.
      Leaves out: point-in-time generations and reconciliation (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7); full-history backfill (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Point-in-time generations and reconciliation
      Objective: Publish the filing-index table as versioned quarter generations behind an active pointer, and reconcile later quarterly changes.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 4's manifest and raw snapshots; Stage 5's shared request budget
      Produces: quarter generations with an active pointer; reconciliation runs with change reports; withdrawal approval
      Exit: a reader that resolves a quarter's pointer sees only one complete generation. A quarterly re-read that adds or changes rows publishes a new generation with a change report. A re-read that removes rows waits for approval tied to its source hash.
      Leaves out: scheduling and deployment (Stage 7); full-history backfill (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

      ROUTING: brainstorming

        - The measured elapsed time and volume are recorded against Stage 2's projection.
